Attendee interest: practical AI agents in C# and Microsoft Foundry.
Session: Agentic AI on Microsoft Foundry: From Function Calling to Multi-Agent Systems
Abstract: This session explores how to build LLM-based AI agents using Microsoft Foundry and the Microsoft Agent Framework. It introduces foundational Agentic AI design patterns such as tool use, reflection, planning, and multi-agent collaboration, demonstrating how they can be implemented to create context-aware and domain specific solutions.

When discussing Agentic AI, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is essential. Expect a brief introduction to MCP and practical guidance on how to implement it in .NET.
